name: PWM Contact Router Lite
author: josbal82

sections.description:
PWM Contact Router Lite is a lightweight contact-routing tool that connects WordPress visitors with a business’s primary contact through a configurable floating button compatible with WhatsApp.

Unlike a generic social icon, it is designed around a clear support workflow: identify the responsible contact, preconfigure the opening message, control where the contact action appears, and give visitors a direct path to the right person.

The Lite version is fully functional for one contact and includes:

  • Configurable contact name, phone number, and initial message.
  • Customizable button text, color, and position.
  • Independent visibility controls for mobile and desktop.
  • A direct link compatible with WhatsApp, including a preconfigured message.
  • Responsive styling isolated from theme styles.
  • No access to or storage of conversations.

Need separate contacts for sales, support, branches, or team members? PWM Contact Router Multicontacto provides unlimited contacts for a one-time payment of $59 MXN.

Learn more: https://pwmplugin.com/wa-multicontacto-facil

PWM Contact Router Lite is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc. WhatsApp is a trademark of its respective owner and is mentioned only to describe compatibility.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “PWM Contact Router Lite” or upload the ZIP file.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open Settings > Contact Router Lite.
  5. Enter the phone number with its country code, without “+”, spaces, or hyphens.
  6. Customize the button and save the settings.
sections.faq:
How many contacts does the Lite version support?

One contact. PWM Contact Router Multicontacto is available for multiple contacts, names, and departments.

Do I need an API or a business account?

No. The plugin generates a WhatsApp link using the configured phone number and message.

Does the plugin store conversations or visitor information?

No. The conversation opens directly in WhatsApp, and the plugin does not read or store its contents.

Can I choose where the button appears?

Yes. You can place it on the left or right and choose whether it appears on mobile devices, desktop computers, or both.

How much does the multicontact version cost?

$59 MXN as a one-time payment. Visit https://pwmplugin.com/wa-multicontacto-facil

  • Loaded detail-screen CSS and JavaScript through the WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Improved the contact-routing description and contributor metadata.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Floating chat button for one contact.
  • Customizable text, color, position, and visibility.
  • Live preview within the settings screen.
  • Information and optional access to PWM Contact Router Multicontacto.
